source.data:
@admin-courses
Feature: Administrator-only course management
  Administrators can view and manage courses.
  Other callers must not read the management catalogue or change courses.

  Background:
    Given an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video

  @BDD-ADM-01
  Scenario: An administrator can view the unpublished course catalogue
    Given I am an "admin"
    When I attempt to "view" a course
    Then the response status should be 200
    And the management catalogue should include the existing unpublished course

  @BDD-ADM-02
  Scenario: An administrator can create a course
    Given I am an "admin"
    When I attempt to "create" a course
    Then the response status should be 200
    And the created course should be returned and saved in the isolated catalogue

  @BDD-ADM-03
  Scenario: An administrator can edit a course
    Given I am an "admin"
    When I attempt to "edit" a course
    Then the response status should be 200
    And the existing course should have the requested title

  @BDD-ADM-04
  Scenario: An administrator can delete a course
    Given I am an "admin"
    When I attempt to "delete" a course
    Then the response status should be 200
    And the existing course should be removed from the isolated catalogue

  Scenario Outline: A <actor> cannot <operation> courses
    Given I am a "<actor>"
    When I attempt to "<operation>" a course
    Then the response status should be <status>
    And the response error should be "<error>"
    And the course catalogue should match its initial state
    And no course management query should reach the repository

    @BDD-ADM-GUEST
    Examples: Guests
      | actor | operation | status | error                                   |
      | guest | view      | 401    | Missing or invalid authorization header |
      | guest | create    | 401    | Missing or invalid authorization header |
      | guest | edit      | 401    | Missing or invalid authorization header |
      | guest | delete    | 401    | Missing or invalid authorization header |

    @BDD-ADM-STUDENT
    Examples: Authenticated students
      | actor   | operation | status | error                            |
      | student | view      | 403    | Forbidden: Admin access required |
      | student | create    | 403    | Forbidden: Admin access required |
      | student | edit      | 403    | Forbidden: Admin access required |
      | student | delete    | 403    | Forbidden: Admin access required |

    @BDD-ADM-INVALID
    Examples: Invalid identities
      | actor            | operation | status | error                       |
      | invalid identity | view      | 401    | Unauthorized: Invalid token |
      | invalid identity | create    | 401    | Unauthorized: Invalid token |
      | invalid identity | edit      | 401    | Unauthorized: Invalid token |
      | invalid identity | delete    | 401    | Unauthorized: Invalid token |

  @BDD-ADM-FAILURE
  Scenario Outline: A repository failure does not report a successful <operation>
    Given I am an "admin"
    And the course repository will fail the "<operation>" operation
    When I attempt to "<operation>" a course
    Then the response status should be 500
    And the response error should be "<error>"
    And the course catalogue should match its initial state

    Examples:
      | operation | error                    |
      | view      | Failed to fetch courses  |
      | create    | Failed to create course  |
      | edit      | Failed to update course  |
      | delete    | Failed to delete course  |

source.data:
@video-access
Feature: Student access to a course video
  Students may receive a video link only when authenticated, paid and enrolled
  in the video's course. Administrators may preview videos without enrollment.

  Background:
    Given an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video

  @BDD-VID-01
  Scenario: A guest cannot obtain a video link
    Given I am a "guest"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 401
    And the response error should be "Missing or invalid authorization header"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed

  @BDD-VID-02
  Scenario: An invalid identity cannot obtain a video link
    Given I am an "invalid identity"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 401
    And the response error should be "Unauthorized: Invalid token"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed

  @BDD-VID-03
  Scenario: A paid enrolled student can access the video
    Given I am a "student"
    And my payment status is "paid"
    And I am enrolled in the video's course
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 200
    And I should receive only the permitted video details

  Scenario Outline: An unpaid student is denied even when enrollment is <enrollment>
    Given I am a "student"
    And my payment status is "unpaid"
    And my enrollment in the video's course is "<enrollment>"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 403
    And the response error should be "Forbidden: User has not paid"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed

    @BDD-VID-04
    Examples: Enrolled but unpaid
      | enrollment |
      | present    |

    @BDD-VID-05
    Examples: Neither paid nor enrolled
      | enrollment |
      | absent     |

  @BDD-VID-06
  Scenario: Payment alone does not grant course access
    Given I am a "student"
    And my payment status is "paid"
    And my enrollment in the video's course is "absent"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 403
    And the response error should be "Forbidden: Not enrolled in this course"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed

  Scenario Outline: An enrollment for <owner> does not grant this access
    Given I am a "student"
    And my payment status is "paid"
    And the only enrollment belongs to "<owner>"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 403
    And the response error should be "Forbidden: Not enrolled in this course"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed

    @BDD-VID-07
    Examples: Wrong course
      | owner          |
      | another course |

    @BDD-VID-08
    Examples: Wrong student
      | owner           |
      | another student |

  @BDD-VID-09
  Scenario: An administrator may preview without payment or enrollment
    Given I am an "admin"
    And my payment status is "unpaid"
    And my enrollment in the video's course is "absent"
    When I request the course video
    Then the response status should be 200
    And I should receive only the permitted video details

  @BDD-VID-10
  Scenario: A paid student receives a clear error for a missing video
    Given I am a "student"
    And my payment status is "paid"
    And I am enrolled in the video's course
    When I request a video that does not exist
    Then the response status should be 404
    And the response error should be "Video not found"
    And the private video link should not be disclosed
